posts.en:
dsh-trajectory-governance is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Agent trajectory governance and anomaly diagnosis: rebuilds flat session logs into multi-branch trajectory trees, detects loop deadlock, invalid retry, and goal drift, alerts with cost attribution, one-click interrupt and breakpoint fork via official APIs, independent GUI tab.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-90eade6eff31742c2d46.html
